item.tib: tshe dbang yang gsang gi sgrub pa
item.coloph: zab par dgongs nas bswe'i sgrom bur gsal/ lan gcig las kyis 'phen len gyis bon nub dus su mi rul ba'i rtsi byug gur gum ser po'i (pos) kha dog bsgyar/ bkra shis pa'i mnga' gsol/ gter kha rnams la sbas pa'i dus su/ gter phud zab gter du sbas nas/ phyis 'don pa'i smon lam dang bcas te sbas pa'o/ sa ma ya/ gsang rgya/ sbas rgya/ gter rgya/ rgya lnga'i (lngas) gdab bo/ phyi rabs las 'phro can dang 'phrad nas kyang / nyi zer lta bur rgyas par shog i thi/ dpon gsas bla ma khyung rgod rtsal la/ 'a zha blo gros kyis zhus so//
